audit.summary: Fixed mean-zero bifurcation range fails; exact fixed projection repairs this step. C4 parameter differentiability and the general full-rotation-group multiplicity also require local correction.
limitations: Limitations: No counterexample to the principal existence theorem is claimed.
Limitations: The local repairs do not certify the entire repaired proof.
Limitations: Findings bind the online-first publisher file; older arXiv v2 not fully compared.
Limitations: Supplement/code and correction searches were bounded.

Physical boundary mean does not define the fixed mean-zero nonlinear range — Counterevidence: At w=0 the linearization preserves zero mean, so linear checks alone do not detect the nonlinear defect. No contradiction to the principal existence theorem was obtained.

The radial solution family is not C1 with values in C4 — Counterevidence: Individual spatial C^{4,alpha} regularity remains compatible; the radial nondegeneracy proof was checked and does not depend on the false C4 parameter claim.

General invariant multiplicity for the full 600-cell rotation group lacks a square — Counterevidence: Degrees 2,4,6,8,10 give 0 and degree12 gives1; squaring preserves all values used to establish (G).
Not performed: Independent proof of all external elliptic regularity, unique continuation and degree theorems
Not performed: Whole-paper or independently accepted verification
The finding applies to the exact reviewed source version and inspected scope; uninspected publication versions are not adjudicated.
The report retains counterevidence and unresolved questions. Publication does not repeat scientific review.
Independent human scientific adjudication remains pending; author adoption has not been requested.

proposition.claim:
S_rho(w)=w-F(rho,w) maps fixed mean-zero C^{2,alpha} to fixed mean-zero C^{1,alpha}.

Actual radial domain pullback; N=2, G=D5, h=cos(5theta)/sqrt(pi); max(rho0,1/sigma)<rho<1/lambda_bar_2; sufficiently small nonzero epsilon; actual PDE solution of Proposition 4.1.

U: (0,lambda_bar_2^{-1}) -> C4(Bbar), rho -> u_rho, is C1.

N=3; rho*=1/(16pi^2) in (0,1/(4pi^2)); unique nodal radius and negative annulus as in Proposition 3.1.

The displayed single-factor character average a_i equals dim H_i(S3)^G for all even i.

G is the full 7200-element rotation group specified in the article, G=(2I x 2I)/diag{+/-1}; i=60 is an allowed even degree.

repair.content:
Replace F by P0 q_w=P0 F, with P0 the fixed sphere mean-zero projection, and S by w-P0F.

Use C1 dependence into C^{2,alpha}_{0,r}(Bbar), 0<alpha<1.

m(i)=a_i^2 for even i and zero for odd i, squaring the whole coefficient and bracket.
